name: Event-hedge desk and hedged baskets on Polymarket rails
one_line: Sell event-risk hedges or packaged baskets (tariffs, elections, rate decisions, weather) to businesses and investors, laying the risk off on Polymarket / Kalshi and earning a structuring margin.
scope: A speculative SERVICE business dropped by the consolidator for regulatory risk: include it, flagged. Cover: who has real event exposure, what the basket / hedge product looks like, depth limits on Polymarket vs the notional a business needs, precedent (Kalshi hedging marketing, weather derivatives, OTC event swaps), the regulatory wall (swap dealing, CFTC, broker / adviser registration, offshore venue access) per evidence pack E9, and the cheapest validation (customer discovery + paper pricing against live books, no capital). Boundary: managed vaults and data products are data-analytics-api-products.
merged_from: wildcard: Event-hedge desk and hedged baskets on Polymarket rails
flags: Highest regulatory risk in the survey: likely requires licensing; offshore venue access for clients is a legal problem.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Event-hedge desk and hedged baskets on Polymarket rails
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Sell businesses and funds a packaged hedge (or a themed basket) built from Polymarket contracts, earning a service fee and maker-side flow instead of taking directional risk.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: 1) Intake: client describes an exposure in plain language (tariff ruling, shutdown, rate path, strike, weather, election outcome affecting a contract). 2) A mapping agent searches live Polymarket (and Kalshi) markets, builds the cheapest basket that offsets the P&L profile, quantifies basis risk from rule text, and sizes against real book depth. 3) Revenue options: advisory/SaaS fee (Blanket-style, non-custodial); being the maker on the other side of the client's flow (uninformed hedging flow is the best flow an LP can get); or packaging standing themed baskets ('tariff-risk', 'Fed-path', 'conflict-risk') as a published index with a rebalancing rule and selling the data/API. 4) On Polymarket US, combos/RFQ gives a native multi-leg quoting surface (per evidence pack E1, not re-fetched) where parlays are documented as overpriced - the desk can be the quoter. 5) Keep custody and execution with the client to stay out of fund/broker regulation.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Price-insensitive hedging flow; product/UX gap - the whole 2026 hedging build-out is on Kalshi and nothing comparable was found for Polymarket's deeper global political/geopolitical books.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: This does not try to beat the price; it monetises being the counterparty and the translator. Demand is real and current: Kalshi+Blanket, Kalshi+USHCC, Game Point Capital sportsbook hedging (taker fees rebated above 300,000 contracts), Tradeweb and Cantor institutional distribution, a conference hedging $3M with a $12k position, Osasuna's $600k relegation hedge. Wall Street is wrapping contracts in ETFs (24+ filings, SEC paused them in May 2026), which leaves on-chain/API baskets open to small teams. Honest limits: hedgers need size and legal certainty that the offshore venue cannot give US corporates; basis risk from rule text is large; E6 found no vault/fund with disclosed TVL or fees, which may mean no demand rather than no supply.
raw_discovery_candidates.adjacent_grounding: Blanket (DeFi Rate 2026-08-07): AI tool mapping business risks to Kalshi contracts - trucking firm $50,000 diesel exposure hedged with $45,000 gross payout for $7,605; bar's $5,000 Knicks hedge. Kalshi Sportsbook Hedging Program filing with Game Point Capital (2026-02-10). Buterin: 'prediction markets should become hedging platforms' (TradingView headline 2026-02-14). Moshrefi et al. on parlay overpricing (arXiv 2607.14430) and automated parlay market makers with O(M^2) loss bounds (arXiv 2607.18299, arXiv 2603.22596, listings only). Dalen, 'Toward Black-Scholes for Prediction Markets' (arXiv 2510.15205, listing only) for basket risk. Insurance analogue: parametric cover.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Regulatory perimeter (advice on event contracts, pooled vehicles, insurance law) - the business can be illegal while each trade is legal; depth too thin for real hedges outside elections/Fed/crypto; rule-text basis risk blows up the hedge (Khamenei last-price settlement on Kalshi); client concentration; Polymarket builds it in-house.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Two-week desk study, no capital: take 30 real exposures (publicly described by SMEs in the Kalshi hedging press) and have the mapping agent build Polymarket baskets; metrics: share with a contract whose payoff correlation to the exposure is plausibly >0.5, and share where depth within 3c covers >=$25k notional. Pass: >=40% on both. Then a landing-page smoke test: 200 targeted visits, pass at >=5% leaving contact details; first pilot as non-custodial advisory only.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Highest legal risk in this list: possible CTA/CPO/broker/insurance-producer registration triggers in the US, MiFID/insurance rules in the EU; Polymarket global excludes US persons; builder/omnibus integrations are excluded from some rebate programs. Get counsel before charging anyone.
